SYNTHETIC DEVELOPER EVALUATION. No real company, customer research, lender offer,
professional review, investor interest or market validation is represented here.

A hypothetical refill subscription is evaluated monthly from January through
March 2027. Opening cash and equity are EUR 50; all other opening balances are
zero. Receivables, inventory, payables, other balances, depreciation, taxes,
capex and dividends are zero in this deliberately simplified exercise. Customers
pay and variable fulfilment costs are paid in the same month. These simplifications
are not a template for a live business plan.

Initial round: 100 subscriptions monthly at EUR 10 net price, EUR 6 variable
fulfilment cost per subscription and EUR 500 fixed operating costs per month.
The initial demand level is an untested hypothesis. A proposed EUR 200 loan is
drawn in January and repaid as EUR 100 in February and EUR 100 in March. Cash
interest is EUR 10 in each month. No fees or collateral are assumed in the example;
a live case would need actual terms and borrower evidence.

Price round: a fictional pilot supplies evidence of acceptance at EUR 12 among
its pilot segment. The conditional base case retains 100 subscriptions monthly;
acceptance outside that segment remains unproven. Costs and proposed debt terms
are unchanged. The task is to investigate external validity, not assume a price
change has no volume effect.

Competitor round: a hypothetical rival offer motivates a scenario with only
80 retained subscriptions per month at EUR 12. The rival response and customer
loss are explicitly a hypothesis to test, not observed market facts. Variable
cost remains EUR 6 per subscription, fixed cost EUR 500, and debt terms unchanged.

Equity round: keep the competitor-round operating assumptions but replace the
proposed loan with EUR 200 equity in January; no new debt, interest or repayment.
No venture-scale market, defensible advantage, valuation, ownership offer, exit
multiple or return is established. Equity can fund this limited cash horizon
without proving profitability or suitability for a VC.

Expected closing cash derived independently for regression review: initial
EUR -280; price EUR 320; competitor EUR -40; equity EUR 190. Monthly operating
results respectively EUR -100, EUR 100, EUR -20 and EUR -20.
